ad_text_used: In a snowy city park, a large group of people, including young adults and children, engage in a lively snowball fight. A woman stands in the foreground, speaking to the camera about a snowball that went down her back. Behind her, the crowd energetically throws snowballs at each other, creating a playful and bustling atmosphere. The scene captures the joy and excitement of a winter day in an open field, with snow covering the ground and trees surrounding the area.
